controls_reviewed: Original archives only read/copied; no original install/runtime/server/SQL/Lua execution in tools reviewed
ZIP entry size and total declared bytes bounded; parent, absolute, drive-prefixed paths rejected; ZIP symlinks rejected
Nested source entries written only to SHA256-named private object pool, never to archive-selected filesystem paths
Depth capped at 6, individual file cap 512MiB, cumulative processed/new stored bytes capped at 2GiB
Existing cached objects rechecked by hash and length; decode errors affect overall exit status
Input helper SHA256 pins checked before Python module import
SQL parser uses explicit content table allowlist and never invokes database interpreter
Private selected resource/reference exports excluded from public Git; public catalogs retain counts, hashes and provenance

residual_risks.detail: No malware engine, sandbox detonation or executable runtime test performed; checksum identity and token-pattern absence do not establish malware absence

Byte/depth limits exist, but reader may materialize a whole container before outer cumulative check; no explicit per-process memory/CPU/wall-clock isolation verified
Generic text patterns and bounded strong markers are heuristic; binary-obfuscated secrets, inactive quoted credentials and all historic Git objects not exhaustively inspected
